name: Bigger Crate
description: Carry 12 items at a time instead of 6.

name: Good Boots
description: Move 30% faster. Feels enormous once the shop gets big.

name: Second Till
description: A second checkout. Queues move twice as fast when both are staffed.

name: Chest Freezer
description: Unlocks selling anything tagged needs-freezer. Ice cream money.

name: Second Field
description: Clear the scrub behind the shop. Four more growing plots.

name: Back Forty
description: Buy the strip along the fence line. Six more plots.

name: Extra Shelving
description: Two more shelf units for the shop floor.

name: Aisle Expansion
description: Knock through the back wall. Three more shelf units.

name: Side Extension
description: Knock through the west wall for three more tiles of shop floor. More room for shelving, and more room to arrange it how you like.

name: Back Extension
description: Push the back wall out by three tiles. Deeper aisles, longer queues before anyone spills onto the street.

name: Hire a Chef
description: Works the appliances: gathers ingredients, makes the products, shelves them.

name: Hire a Clerk
description: Mans the till and takes payment so shoppers stop walking out of the queue.

name: Hire a Farmhand
description: Plants, harvests and walks the produce to a shelf.

name: Hire a Shop Hand
description: Tills, deliveries and shelves — and picks the odd ripe plot when the shop is quiet.

name: Hire a Stocker
description: Buys wholesale and keeps the shelves full while you are out back.

name: Blender
description: Turns produce into salsa and smoothies.

name: Coffee Machine
description: Beans and milk in, a proper flat white out.

name: Toaster Oven
description: Bakes and toasts. Bread in, better bread out.
